ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels to 15% low-intensity black pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field; thick black continuous perimeter along the trailing edge and tips. A vertical black bifurcated wedge extends from the peduncle connection to the median notch. Two distinct dark circular blobs (focal spots) are located in the mid-section of each lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 55 degrees; depth is significant relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced at the terminal tips and immediately lateral to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to a convex sweep at the outer terminal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-contrast, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (scars) located symmetrically on the white interior of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the left lobe, extending from the peduncle-fluke junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct circular scarring on both lobes, potentially indicative of previous parasitic attachment or predation attempts.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical placement of focal dark spots on the white ventral field, resembling eyes.
